en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of open fields leading to a lake, with a forested shoreline in the distance. In the right foreground stands a small dark wooden farmhouse beside a tree and a traditional split‑rail fence running across the scene. There are a few grazing animals in the fields and several telephone poles. White printed captions appear at the bottom with the location name and photographer's credit.
